description: Directly update an existing use case's fields without invoking the LLM. Pass only the fields you want to change — others are left untouched. Use this for cheap, deterministic edits (rename, flip status DRAFT→APPROVED, change priority, edit acceptance criteria). For LLM regeneration from a new instruction, use muggle-remote-use-case-update-from-prompt instead. Note: a real change to title, description, or url triggers background regeneration of dependent test cases on the server; restating a stored value does not. Regeneration replaces the use case's test cases, which drops the limits stored in their descriptions; store them again afterwards.

useCaseBreakdown.description: Updated main/alternative/error flows as requirement + acceptance criteria pairs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concrete, measurable acceptance criteria for the requirement

requirement.description: One requirement of the use case

name: muggle-remote-use-case-update
